ios.desc:
Go where only Michigan can take you.

Freshwater shores. Sweeping dunes. Northern forests. A lighthouse at the end of the road. Discover the places that make Michigan worth exploring, and find your next stop with Explore Michigan.

FOLLOW YOUR CURIOSITY
Browse parks and lighthouses across both peninsulas. Explore destinations on the map, search by place, city or county, and filter by location type to find the places that speak to you.

SEE WHAT'S WAITING
Take a closer look with destination photos and available information about activities, visitor resources and more. Photos and details vary by location.

TURN A DISCOVERY INTO A DAY OUT
Open a destination's website, share a place with someone, or get directions through Apple Maps. Find useful maps, guides and reservation links where available.

MORE MICHIGAN IN VIEW
Explore on iPhone and iPad. Browse the location list alongside the map on iPad and the open iPhone Duo display, then take a closer look at a place that catches your eye.

A little Michigan. Wherever you go.
